name: Thye Ming Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Thye Ming Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells lead alloys and lead oxide in Asia. The company provides litharge, red lead, antimonial and calcium lead alloys, metal, and lead ingots. Its products are also used in storage battery, PVC stabilizer, lead glass, ceramic glaze, pigment, crystal and optical glass, paint, terminal connector, type metal, casting metal, fishnet sinker, lead oxide, solder, lead brick, and lead plate applications.
